$comment: The MingCute icons this library ships, by their MingCute name. Run `pnpm icons` after editing.
Find a name with the MingCute MCP server (search_icons), or browse https://mingcute.com.
`regular` is MingCute's stroked outline style, which is what the Figma library uses;
`filled` is the solid style, and generates a component with a `Filled` suffix.
